---
title: "Madh E Shah E Do Alam Ki Kya Baat Hai Lyrics 2018"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Naat"
poet: "Akbar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Madh-e-Shah-e-Do Alam Ki Kya Baat Hai.
Hamd Ki Hamd Hai Naat Ki Naat Hai.
Aik Do Shab Musafat Ka Kya Tazkira.
Unn Ki Har Raat Mairaj Ki Raat Hai.

2
Sorah-e-Fatah Ke Baiti Aidihim.
Jis Pe Bait Karein Aap Ka Hath Hai.
Zaat Ki Ayhad-e-Fakhar-o-Mubahaat Mein.
Mustafa Ki Ghulami Meri Zaat Hai.

3
Boond Dar Boond Sab Aayatein Aayatein.
Sehan Mein Tees Paron Ki Barsaat Hai.
Kuch Tu Musa Ko Batlaein Jalwah Hai Kya.
Aap Ki Tu Khuda Se Mulaqaat Hai.

4
Unn Ko Ajwa Hai Khak-e-Baqaiya Humein.
Apni Apni Madina Ki Sogat Hai.
Hai Qasam Shehar Ki Aap Ke Shehar Ki.
Iss Ke Aagay Tu Janat Bhi Dehaat Hai.

5
Karbala, Mashhad-o-Kazmain-o-Najaf.
Woh Madina Hai Jo Shehar-e-Sadaat Hai.
Hai Anayaat-e-Aaqa Se Akbar Sukhan.
Warna Lafz-o-Lugat Ki Yeh Auqaat Hai.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/madh-e-shah-e-do-alam-ki-kya-baat-hai-lyrics-2018-tajpoints-c568e3f282ce11531053.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---',2)
for version, numbers in [(front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1], '12345'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵')]:
    blocks = version.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 5
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
        assert all(not line.endswith('.') for line in lines)
print('Verified five matching four-verse stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script for all 20 verses and verified that both versions have five matching four-verse stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, set the direction to `rtl`, and removed `noUrdu`. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.

I read the ambiguous Roman phrases “baiti aidihim,” “ayhad,” and “Baqaiya” as بیعتِ ایدیہم، عہد، and بقیع.
